heraliz_usure.ecran.aide.categories: Wear / shot: % of condition lost per bullet (≈ shots: from 100 % to 0 %). Rain, water, suppressor: extra wear when firing in rain, in water or with a suppressor. No jams, no damage or accuracy loss: only a ruined weapon (0 %) won't fire.
heraliz_usure.ecran.aide.etats: Thresholds split the weapon's condition (display, bar colour). Wear changes nothing when firing, except at 0 %: the weapon is ruined and won't fire until repaired. Right column: how many shots an assault rifle spends in each condition.
heraliz_usure.ecran.aide.reparation: In the inventory, pick up the kit then right-click the weapon. The kit restores part of the condition up to its cap. Each repair lowers the maximum condition a little: a heavily repaired weapon never becomes pristine again. Kits are neither in crates nor craftable for now.
heraliz_usure.ecran.aide.armes: A row replaces the category values for one weapon (tacz:ak47) or a group (heralisz_skins:*__*). Empty box = category value (grey). Excluded: the weapon never wears (knives, zombies-mode weapons).
heraliz_usure.ecran.aide.accessoires: Extra wear (%) when this TaCZ attachment is mounted on the weapon (on top of the category suppressor value).
heraliz_usure.ecran.aide.general: Weapons never wear during matches (duels, ClashWar, zombies: loaned weapons). Changes reach every player as soon as they are saved.
heraliz_usure.ecran.general.creatif.aide: Weapons also wear for players in creative mode.
heraliz_usure.ecran.general.match.aide: Duels, ClashWar, zombies: weapons are loaned, they don't wear.
heraliz_usure.ecran.general.hud.aide: Small condition indicator in the bottom right corner of the screen (each player can also turn it off).
heraliz_usure.reglages.sous_titre: How your weapons' condition is shown
heraliz_usure.reglages.hud.aide: The ruined alert is always shown.
